notes.title: Build Update
notes.content:
- Quest system completely reworked under the hood to make it easier to expand with new quests and polish existing ones. Previously it was one massive quest system, now changed to a modular approach  
- Added UI for quest tracking with journal records  
- UI polishing continues, a few steps closer to full gamepad support  
- Reworked detection logic for enemy AI – detection now depends on whether the player is standing or crouching, and if wearing equipment that affects visibility  
- Equipment now has CAMOUFLAGE modifiers – larger numbers mean the player can be detected from shorter distances. Stance and movement also affect detection chance  
- Starting area level art update  
- Some level art work on the global map  
- Added new UNI set for uniforms  
- Added new animation for sprinting with rifle  
- Small fixes and tweaks

notes.title: Gamepad integration update
notes.content:
[p]Thank you everyone for the feedback! I've made some progress with gamepad integration, and it can now be tested in-game.

I've implemented a Bloodborne/Souls-like target lock system that activates automatically when a gamepad is in use. To lock onto a target, press the aim input in the direction of the enemy, and the system will lock the camera. It should feel familiar. You can switch targets or unlock by pressing the aim input again.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185066/e1f926c4fac39ae23baa9f0cfcceb840515b8eb4.png"][/img]
Please note that aim lock does not work when using a keyboard and mouse. I plan to add it as an optional feature in the future, but it will be disabled by default.

Some default control mappings have also been updated. The game still requires a keyboard and mouse for certain menu interactions, so this isn’t full controller support yet. Your feedback would be greatly appreciated!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185066/fba3797505c8b23c28b986bfc4c8c02fbe81636c.png"][/img]
As an additional note, cloud saves have now been enabled.[/p]

tags.feature: I've implemented a Bloodborne/Souls-like target lock system that activates automatically when a gamepad is in use.
As an additional note, cloud saves have now been enabled.

Big thanks to everyone for playing, reporting bugs, sharing ideas, and helping shape Trench Tales. Every bit of feedback helps — especially during Early Access.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185066/bb224d9d24fe57478986bbab4d451de83ec9ad67.jpg"][/img]

A new feature kicks in if you go idle for 5 seconds — the game will switch to free camera mode, so you can get a better look at your character.
If you snap a cool shot, share it! Who knows — just like before, your screenshot might even end up as an in-game billboard or poster in a future update.[/p][p]

Thanks again for being part of this world — more to come soon!

notes.title: Dev Update – Nearly 2 Months in Early Access!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]It’s been almost two months since [b]Trench Tales[/b] launched into Early Access, and I want to give a [b]huge thank you[/b] to all of you who have supported the game, shared feedback, and helped steer it forward. Every comment, bug report, and review means a lot — especially to a solo developer like me.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185066/50151ef4dab1c866655980505cef21444d940325.png"][/img][/p][h3]Lore Spotlight – [i]Up or Out[/i], a Short Story by A. Byss[/h3][p]If you're curious about the world behind the trenches, check out [i]Up or Out [/i]written by[i] [/i]A. Byss [/p][p]— a gritty short story set in the Trench Tales universe. It follows a desperate private caught between ambition, betrayal, and survival, giving a closer look at the everyday horrors and politics of war beyond the battlefield.[/p][p][url="https://trenchtales.com/blogs/news/up-or-out-short-story-by-a-byss"]READ[/url][/p][p]The story is written in English. I recommend using [b]DeepL Translator[/b], which lets you upload the PDF and download a translated version in your language.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185066/3bd0c1c306f2ac20759364f91894c744df7b37b4.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Progress Highlights[/h3][list][*][p][b]60+ bugs fixed[/b] so far (and counting!)[/p][/*][*][p]New items added as loot and equipment [/p][/*][*][p]Improvements across AI, UI, controls, tutorial and performance[/p][/*][*][p]Visual updates and ongoing work on level art and characters[/p][/*][*][p]I am doing my best  to keep regular patches and content updates continue[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185066/05f477602bd30c5e50c7dcb091e4af200bc46c22.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Still a Long Road Ahead…[/h3][p]The game is still in development, but things are looking [b]very positive[/b]. notes.title: Major Engine Update V_6f5
notes.content:
Engine Update – Unreal Engine 5.5.4

A major engine upgrade from 5.2 to 5.5.4. This brings a number of changes under the hood—from physics to rendering. The goal is to improve performance and provide more stable framerates across different systems.

Update notes:

-    Engine upgraded from 5.2 to 5.5.4
-    Updated AMD FSR
-    Removed overly sensitive ragdoll trigger when rolling near edges or falling from small heights
-   Ragdoll fixes for enemies and NPCs
-    Some texture size optimization
-    Various small fixes and improvements

🛠️ Please note: Due to the engine upgrade, this update may require a large download. Apologies for the inconvenience, and thank you for your patience.

📈 Looking forward to the next Unreal Engine 5.6 update—Epic promises a significant performance boost in rendering, which should further improve stability and frame rates.

tags.bug: - Removed overly sensitive ragdoll trigger when rolling near edges or falling from small heights
- Ragdoll fixes for enemies and NPCs

notes.title: Build Update V_6f4
notes.content:
Short-Term Contracts System. Second iteration

The Contracts system has been updated! You can now take on short, standalone missions from certain NPCs and from Shrines of Death Wishes.

🗺️ Two small levels have been added to test the system:

    One mission is available from the Merchants of Death, west of the old farm

    Another from the Shrine of Death Wishes, east of the Meeting Point (near the “Parcel” quest)

🧭 Contracts can now be tracked from the menu—making it easier to follow your objectives.

🎒 As a reward, you can unlock a new Austrian-style backpack!

🛠️ Also included:

    General performance improvements for enemy AI

    System groundwork for future contract content

A quick note: while recent work may not have been immediately visible, this system is a major step toward enriching the gameplay loop. Verden is a world at war, and sometimes someone just needs an extra hand—and that might be you.

📅 More updates coming Friday!

notes.title: Build update v_0.6d3
notes.content:
Fixes and Changes

  -  Kick Skill Update
    The kick skill now only consumes a charge when it hits an enemy. You can use it freely to destroy environmental objects without cost.

-    Key Binding Fixes
    Fixed an issue where custom key bindings weren’t working properly. Flashlight was hard-coded to "L"—this has now been corrected.

-    Shoulder Swap Key Renamed
    In the key binding menu, the shoulder swap function was previously listed as "CAMREA." It has now been renamed for clarity.

-    ESC Key Now Closes Pause Menu
    You can now exit the pause menu using the ESC key.

-    Bleeding Damage Added
    Enemies can now apply bleeding to the player.
    This effect appears in the STATUS section on the right side of the screen.
    Bleeding has a timer but can be removed by using healing items.

notes.title: First Update and Hotfixes v_06d
notes.content:
Video Settings
 - Added multiple resolution options for better flexibility.

UI Adjustments
-  Slight rework to the settings screen. The background blur was removed so you can still see the game while adjusting settings in-game.

Key Binding Hotfix
- Some players had issues with key bindings not saving. The problem was caused by unclear UI logic. The button meant to apply changes was labelled "BACK," so many people just hit ESC to exit—thinking settings were already saved, when they actually weren’t.
This has now been fixed. The UI should be clearer, and settings will apply as expected.
